Mass spectra were acquired in SPS MS3 mode and FAIMS (-45, -55, -65, and -75 V) with the following settings: MS1 —120k resolution, max IT 50 ms, AGC target 400,000; MS2 — IW 0.7 CID fragmentation, CE 35%, max IT 35 ms, ion trap rapid scan rate, AGC target 10,000; MS3 reporter quantitation — 10 2 m/z notches, HCD fragmentation, CE 55%, 50k resolution, max IT 86 ms, AGC target 100,000.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: 50 µg of protein was reduced and alkylated with 10 mM TCEP (5 min, 80 °C) and 40 mM 2-chloroacetamide (15 min, room temperature) and peptides prepared by SP4, as described previously (doi: 10.1021/acs.analchem.1c04200).
For poly-ubiquitylome sample preparation, 100 μg of cell lysate were reduced and alkylated (10 mM TCEP and 20 mM 2-chloroacetamide), and diluted in IP buffer.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The pelleted precipitate was digested in a Thermomixer Comfort (18 h, 1,000 rpm, 37 °C) with sequencing-grade modified trypsin (Promega, Cat# V5111) at 1:100 enzyme:protein ratio in 50 mM HEPES pH 8.0, before proceeding to TMT labelling.

enrichment_method.evidence: Magne HaloTag beads (Promega, Cat# G7281) conjugated to a custom-made trypsin-resistant Tandem-Ubiquitin-Binding-Entity (trTUBE) with an N-terminal HaloTag separated by a tobacco-etch-virus protease cleavage site (HaloTag—[tev]—trTUBE).

fractionation_method.evidence: fractionated with a Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation Kit (Thermo Scientific, Cat# 84868), according to the manufacturer’s instructions, adapted to required fraction numbers.

instrument.evidence: LC-MS analysis. TMT-labelled high-pH peptide fractions were analysed by Orbitrap Eclipse MS (Thermo Scientific) with on-line separation on a reversed-phase nanoLC column (450 mm × 0.075 mm ID) packed with ReprosilPur C18AQ (Dr Maisch, 3 μm particles).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: TMT-labelled high-pH peptide fractions were analysed by Orbitrap Eclipse MS (Thermo Scientific) with on-line separation on a reversed-phase nanoLC column (450 mm × 0.075 mm ID) packed with ReprosilPur C18AQ (Dr Maisch, 3 μm particles).

labeling.evidence: Digested peptides were labelled with TMTpro 18-plex in 50 mM HEPES pH 8.0, quenched with 0.4 % hydroxylamine (15 min, room temperature), pooled and dried by vacuum concentration.
